visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The frame is split horizontally. The top shows a 3D animated fox with orange fur and a green shirt, looking calmly into the lens as if adjusting a camera. The bottom shows a real-life woman with her dark hair styled in two buns, wearing a light-colored floral blouse, mimicking the fox's initial contemplative gaze. (2) In the top panel, an animated grey rabbit wearing a blue police uniform suddenly rushes into the frame from the left, hugging the fox tightly around the neck. Simultaneously, in the bottom panel, a young man in a cream-colored sweater vest over a white shirt pops in from the left to hug the woman. (3) The video transitions through a series of quick-cut frames, each preceded by a white flash. On top, the fox and rabbit strike various playful poses, from leaning in close to making silly faces. Below, the human couple precisely recreates every movement and facial expression of the animated characters in real-time. (4) The final sequence shows a heartfelt pose where both pairs embrace warmly. The animated fox and rabbit are cheek-to-cheek with joyful expressions, while the real-life couple mirrors this intimacy, looking directly at the camera. The background in both remains minimalist and brightly lit, focusing entirely on the subjects.
